payload.text:
Prove this Lean 4 theorem (source: FATE-H, difficulty: medium).

Informal statement:
Prove that a group with exactly 56 elements is not simple.

Formal statement to prove:
theorem fateh_002_not_isSimpleGroup_of_card_eq_56 {G : Type} [Group G] (hG : Nat.card G = 56) :
    ¬ IsSimpleGroup G

Each role chooses its next allowed action. Use search_lemmas and compiler tools when they resolve real uncertainty. Hand off only when the receiving role can act on concrete mathematical, compiler, or review evidence. A non-linear route is allowed, but extra communication is not itself success. The final proof must compile, preserve the exact statement, and contain no sorry, admit, or added axiom.

tool_calls.name: search_lemmas
tool_calls.arguments: {"query":"lemma about finite groups of order 56 not simple Sylow theorem number of Sylow 7-subgroups divides 8 and is congruent to 1 mod 7"}

tool_responses.content:
Top matches (name signature -- description):
card_sylow_modEq_one  [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ≡ 1 [MOD p]  -- Sylow's Theorem: Number of Sylow $p$-Subgroups ≡ 1 mod $p$
Sylow.card_dvd_index  [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] (P : Sylow p G) : Nat.card (Sylow p G) ∣ P.index  -- Sylow's Theorem: Number of Sylow p-Subgroups Divides the Index
Sylow.card_eq_index_normalizer  [Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] (P : Sylow p G) : Nat.card (Sylow p G) = P.normalizer.index  -- Number of Sylow p-subgroups equals index of normalizer
not_dvd_card_sylow  [hp : Fact p.Prime] [Finite (Sylow p G)] : ¬p ∣ Nat.card (Sylow p G)  -- Number of Sylow $ p $-subgroups is not divisible by $ p $
Sylow.card_eq_multiplicity  [Finite G] {p : ℕ} [hp : Fact p.Prime] (P : Sylow p G) : Nat.card P = p ^ Nat.factorization (Nat.card G) p  -- Sylow's Theorem: Order of Sylow $ p $-Subgroup Equals $ p^{\text{ord}_p(|G|)} $
